handoffs.title: Cargo raw facts → Build-State Pack
handoffs.producer: Tooling Contract / Semantic Context via Cargo raw-fact surfaces
entry_artifacts: cargo metadata JSON with explicit format-version
optional unstable cargo report data when explicitly enabled
transforms: normalize per-run Cargo facts into a persisted pack
separate stable raw facts from unstable prototype imports
attach path/layout caveats and migration notes
emit diff and doctor views over the captured pack
output_receipts: doctor note with unsupported-state and migration caveats
stable_surfaces: documented Cargo environment variables where applicable
unstable_or_service_boundaries: cargo report remains unstable and prototype-stage
build-dir layout details are internal-only and actively changing
notes: This is the first receipt edge to harden because several other seams should import the pack rather than scrape Cargo directly.
The key discipline is keeping stable and unstable facts visibly separate inside the pack.

handoffs.title: Build-State Pack → Debug Acceptance Matrix
handoffs.consumer: Feedback / Debug Acceptance Commons through debug-acceptance-matrix/v0
transforms: bind fixture build facts to debugger/OS/runtime tuples
collect session exports or normalized session notes
compare tuple state over time with explicit unsupported-state posture
stable_surfaces: documented environment variables for locating built binaries
machine-readable test output where stabilized or otherwise explicitly supported
unstable_or_service_boundaries: debugger export formats may differ by tool and version
some test output and debugger capabilities remain uneven or evolving
refused_collapses: hiding yellow/red tuple states behind synthetic green summaries
handoffs.credible_home: debug-acceptance-matrix/v0 companion repo plus tuple-corpus stewarding
notes: This edge matters because debug issue handoff improves when build receipts already exist and do not need to be reconstructed later.
The matrix should import build truth, not silently redefine it.

handoffs.title: Registry/security truth → Intake Review Kit
handoffs.consumer: Package Intake + Release Boundary Review through intake-review-kit/v0
entry_artifacts: security-tab or vulnerability surfacing data when available
transforms: apply route profile to the incoming service truth
convert service-side facts into local admit, waive, quarantine, or recheck decisions
store expiry-bearing waiver and escalation receipts
stable_surfaces: published crates.io settings and index fields
unstable_or_service_boundaries: service truth is not the same thing as a universal trust judgment
capability analysis imports may remain optional and tool-specific
alternate registries may differ materially from crates.io
refused_collapses: registry-global gate that replaces local review
service UI treated as the complete review artifact
handoffs.credible_home: intake-review-kit/v0 companion repo importing official registry truth
notes: This edge is the clearest urgent operator handoff in the archive.
The main design task is to keep service truth and local judgment visibly separate.

handoffs.title: Structured API facts → Release-Boundary Review
handoffs.producer: Tooling Contract / Semantic Context and compatibility-analysis tooling
handoffs.consumer: Compatibility Claims and release-boundary review inside the intake kit
entry_artifacts: docs.rs or locally generated rustdoc JSON
witness programs and cargo check results
transforms: separate structured API facts from inferred compatibility claims
run or attach witness-program checks for uncertain edges
emit a release-boundary review with explicit unknowns and overrides
stable_surfaces: rustdoc JSON artifacts with declared format_version
cargo check as the stable witness runner
unstable_or_service_boundaries: docs.rs availability and historical rebuild state are service-dependent
rustdoc JSON still lacks some precise information needed for certain semver checks
cargo-semver-checks integration into cargo publish is still goal-stage, not shipped default behavior
refused_collapses: pretending hosted rustdoc JSON is always present and current
treating one witness result as the whole release story
handoffs.credible_home: release-boundary module inside intake-review-kit/v0 plus compatibility-claims helpers
notes: This edge is a major reason compatibility claims stay slightly behind the first build pair: the artifact story is improving but still caveat-heavy.
Witness generation is the honest bridge when structured facts are insufficient on their own.

handoffs.title: Intake + compatibility receipts → Safety Readiness Cards
handoffs.producer: Package Intake + Release Boundary Review and Compatibility Claims
handoffs.consumer: Safety-Critical + Institutional Readiness Commons through readiness-cards/v0
transforms: map package and compatibility posture into readiness cards
separate low-criticality convenience from high-criticality acceptance posture
attach target, dependency lifecycle, async, and interop caveats
stable_surfaces: local review receipts and card schemas
target tier and package metadata that can be cited directly
unstable_or_service_boundaries: high-criticality readiness remains stewardship-heavy and domain-specific
service or project-goal signals do not by themselves prove qualification readiness
refused_collapses: treating package review as sufficient proof for institutional readiness
handoffs.credible_home: readiness-cards/v0 corpus with consortium or foundation-backed stewardship
notes: This is a bridge from operator receipts into institution-facing readiness, not a direct cargo or crates.io feature request.
The crucial rule is to preserve missing evidence explicitly instead of forcing premature readiness claims.

handoffs.title: Reviewed receipts → Conservative defaults and atlas guidance
handoffs.producer: Build, intake, debug, and readiness receipts already reviewed by their local owners
transforms: summarize reviewed receipts into narrow defaults
preserve stale, unknown, and reconsider triggers
link outward to the underlying receipts instead of replacing them
stable_surfaces: the underlying reviewed receipts and source citations
renewal queues and explicit review cadence
unstable_or_service_boundaries: navigation remains renewal-heavy and should not claim timeless truth
LLM-mediated usage increases the need for receipt links and source-candor
handoffs.credible_home: navigation/defaults corpus with strict renewal discipline
notes: This edge keeps navigation downstream of reviewed evidence instead of letting it become free-floating recommendation prose.
It is intentionally last because better defaults depend on the earlier edges being real first.
